siteUrl.title: Data from Bolmen Research Station - SITES Data Portal

general.abstract: Bolmen Research Station is located in Tiraholm, by Lake Bolmen in Hylte municipality. The research at the station primarily focuses on environmental monitoring, fish conservation and management, water conservation and the effects of climate change on freshwater ecosystems.
